findings.claim: OTTO SEO applies its on-page changes client-side, via a JavaScript snippet, rather than at CMS level.
findings.why_it_matters: Google renders JavaScript, so rendered-only changes can still be picked up on the render pass. Most LLM crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot) do not execute JavaScript, so rendered-only changes are invisible to them.
findings.status: reported by third-party reviewers; verifiable per-site with otto_visibility_check.py in this repo

findings.claim: Organic traffic estimate diverged sharply from Google Search Console on the reviewer's own site: 15,500 estimated vs 1,650 actual (~9x).
findings.why_it_matters: Single-site anecdote, not a benchmark. Treat any third-party traffic estimator as directional; reconcile against GSC before reporting to a client.
findings.status: single documented case, n=1, not independently reproduced

findings.claim: Report loading times of 2-5 minutes and occasional platform crashes.
LLM visibility tracking limited to two domains.
findings.status: reported by third-party reviewer; plan-dependent, confirm against your own tier

findings.claim: 40 landing page credits per month on the Growth plan.
Not the deepest backlink index; less historical depth than Ahrefs. Cannot replace a specialist tool for backlink forensics.
findings.status: reviewer judgement, not a measured index-size comparison

findings.claim: Automated deployment of on-page changes needs human review before it touches important pages.
findings.status: reviewer judgement, echoed across multiple reviews

findings.claim: The vendor publishes MCP servers on GitHub, so the platform can be driven from an AI agent rather than the dashboard.

third_party_scores.caveat: Vendor-review sites frequently monetise via affiliate links. Scores are recorded here as reported, not endorsed.
Vendor homepage displays G2 (3,200+ reviews), Capterra, Gartner and Global Search Awards badges without a numeric rating on the page itself. Recorded as a vendor claim, unverified here.

known_unknowns: No independent, multi-site benchmark of Search Atlas traffic estimates against GSC exists publicly. The 9x figure is n=1.
No public measurement of how much of OTTO's output Google actually indexes after the render pass, versus how much is dropped.
No published index-size comparison between Search Atlas's backlink index and Ahrefs/Semrush.
G2/Capterra aggregate scores are not recorded here because the numeric value was not readable on a public page at check time.
